prompts.house:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent building cutout for a charming anime isometric RPG.
Image 1 is reference for exact rendering style and orthographic camera angle only, not an edit target.
Draw one beautiful two-storey ochre-plaster townhouse with warm terracotta roof tiles, blue-green shutters, small flower-filled balcony, ivy, a dark timber door and a little striped awning over the ground-floor shop window. A welcoming inhabited European-inspired anime town, painterly anime background detail, attractive warm colors, clean readable forms.
Use the SAME view as the reference: orthographic isometric front-right corner view, upright perfectly vertical walls, straight structural beams, two ground axes sloping about 27 degrees upward left and upward right; no fisheye, no leaning, no warped perspective. Full standalone house from chimney tip to doorstep inside the frame with generous clear transparent margin. House front faces toward lower-left, its right side visible. The front doorstep is its lowest point. Single connected structure, no separate props or people outside it.
Real transparent background. No ground plane, no cast ground shadow, no sky, no text, no logos, no multiple views, no grid, no frame.
prompts.paving:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeatable paving-material texture for a native isometric anime RPG town.
Primary request: a square top-down material swatch of beautiful pale honey limestone sidewalk paving, varied small rectangular and square stone slabs, fine sandy grout, subtle hand-painted edge highlights and warm mineral variations, understated tiny moss only in a few seams. Entire image is only the material, uniform scale all across, flat overhead view, no perspective, no shadows from objects, no vignette, no borders. Painterly Japanese animation background finish, high-frequency delicate stone detail, soft diffuse neutral daylight. Seamless tiling edges, no large distinctive pattern or focal motif, no characters, no buildings, no text.

usage: Original PNGs copied byte-for-byte. House uses a native AtlasTexture region; paving repeats through the district's fixed isometric ground geometry. Existing town architecture, trees, stalls and characters are reused.
